label: input e at early-mid original positions (t=3-6) in a 0/d ... v g context
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.016% of steps), almost entirely in the original phase at t=3-6 (peak t=4); never fires in the copy phase, only weakly at the delimiter. 74% of activation mass is on input token e. Magnitude rises with a conjunction of context cues: first token 0 or d (first_tok 0 has 18x lift), previous token g (13x), and v one to three steps back. The strongest examples look like 0 _ v g e. The predicate (e at t=3-6 with at least 2 of these 3 cues) gets dev P=0.47, R=0.22, mass recall 0.38. Plain e at t=3-6 covers 74% of mass but has 1% precision, so e alone is far from sufficient; the feature behaves like a soft AND over a specific prefix pattern. Weak activations also land on non-e tokens that follow g or v in the same kind of context. Does not fire at t<3, at t>=7, or on e in other contexts (e.g. without the 0/d start or the g/v neighbors).
